items.title: Manuel "Fess" Manetta Interview, 1957-03-21
items.q: the band we had there was piano, violin, and drum. I was playing piano. Pete Buckeye was playing violin.

ctx.x: What kind of bands did they have at Anderson's Endings?

Well, I tell you, the band we had there was piano, violin, and drum. I was playing piano. Pete Buckeye was playing violin. Chris Minor was playing drum. They didn't usually have a big band with trumpets and trombones? Oh, no. That's the hammer. Now, where they had the full bands, that was in the dance halls. Well, they had about a dozen dance halls. Who were some of the dance halls? Rice's?
Rice's? Rice's? They had the Rice Dance Hall.
